topic: How Uranus was discovered and named
script: Uranus was the first planet discovered with a telescope. William Herschel spotted it on March 13, 1781. At first, he thought it was a comet. He wanted to name it after King George the Third. The name Uranus, after the Greek god of the sky, was adopted later. Under very dark skies, Uranus is just bright enough to see with your eyes.
